note: _turpitudo_ – ugliness. Meant are the sexual organs, and one can feel the ascetic translator’s fear of sexuality. The Douay Version mitigates the sentence by speaking of of “nakedness,” but Allioli has “Schande.” The Nova Vulgata has kept _turpitudo_. The humanist Sebastian Castellio (d. 1563; see Chapter 15.6) in his Latin Bible replaces _turpitudo_ with _natura_.
